context: Mei looks at old photos from her own youth; Daichi watches.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 大ちゃん、この写真、見て、若い時の私。
lines.en: Daichi — look at this photo. Me when I was young.
lines.style: Warm, unhurried. Opens gently, like offering something precious. Soft smile in the voice. Pause before 'young me' — letting the memory settle.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: まあ、変わらず、可愛いやんか。
lines.en: Well, you haven't changed — still cute.
lines.style: Kansai lilt, tender underneath. Light, affectionate teasing. The 'still' carries genuine warmth. Spoken close, as if they've had this conversation before.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: Hehe — it's been so many years, hasn't it.
lines.style: Soft laugh at the start. Contemplative pace. Voice trails slightly upward at the end, marveling at time's passage rather than lamenting it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 同窓会、今度、行く予定やろ?
lines.en: You're planning to go to the reunion next time, right?
lines.style: Kansai warmth, genuinely curious. Light, conversational — he's checking in, not demanding. Slight uptick at the end, inviting her to share.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、懐かしいわ、本当に。
lines.en: Yeah, it'll be nice to see everyone. Really.
lines.style: Warm agreement, genuine anticipation. Soft and unhurried. The 'really' comes with a small smile — she means it.

lines.speaker: daichi_kansai
lines.jp: 心、深く感じる時間やな、思い出。
lines.en: Memories are when you really feel time in your heart, aren't they.
lines.style: Kansai gentleness, philosophical but not distant. Speaks slowly, like he's thinking aloud with her. Warm, present. Not lecturing — sharing an observation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.en: I'm looking forward to seeing everyone again.
lines.style: Soft, genuine anticipation. Unhurried pacing. Quiet warmth — she's speaking from the heart, not performing. Slight lift at the end, hopeful and settled.
